Karrinyup Wellness Centre is a health and wellness centre based in Karrinyup, Perth (Western Australia). They specialise in holistic healing treatments like chiropractic adjustments, massage therapy, dry needling, kinesiology and more. They have a team of expert chiropractors, massage therapists, naturopaths, kinesiologists and a dietitian who are dedicated to providing the best care possible. They offer and provide an integrated holistic approach to health and design the treatments based on the needs of their clients. They specialise in chiropractic treatments for pregnant women, children and senior citizens.

Learn more about Karrinyup Wellness Centre Chiropractic Clinic at https://wellness-centre.com.au/
